from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
from contextlib import closing
import json
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import os

from stellar_forge_buyer.dbnomics import (
    DbnomicsAnalysisSource, DbnomicsEconomicWorkflow, canonical, keep, need,
    native, pin, write_exact,
)
from stellar_forge_buyer.storage import private_directory, read, parse


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, allow_abbrev=False)
    parser.add_argument("--checkout", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--node", default="node")
    parser.add_argument("--project", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--operation", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--receiving-id", default="dbnomics-insee-ipc-20261012")
    parser.add_argument("--title", default="Insee annual and monthly economic briefing, including imputed rents")
    parser.add_argument("--review-note", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--annotation", help="Actual analyst commentary to return in the original Records sheet")
    parser.add_argument("--observation-id", help="Exact original observation identity for the supplied commentary")
    parser.add_argument("--author", default="Economic analyst")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    root = private_directory(Path(args.operation).expanduser().absolute())
    project = Path(args.project).expanduser().absolute()
    need(bool(args.annotation) == bool(args.observation_id), "EXACT_ANNOTATION_OBSERVATION_REQUIRED")
    status = native(args.checkout, args.node, ["project-status", "--workspace", str(project)])
    # This uses the complete original native receiving result, not a new source.
    receiving = parse(read(project / "receiving" / args.receiving_id / "result.json", 32 * 1024 * 1024))
    captures = status["captures"]
    need(len(captures) == 1, "SELECT_THE_ORIGINAL_COMPLETE_RECEIVING_PROJECT")
    capture = captures[0]
    need(receiving.get("schema") == "stellar-forge.dbnomics-receiving-result.v1" and
         receiving.get("operationId") == args.receiving_id and
         receiving.get("projectId") == status["project"]["id"] and
         receiving.get("capture", {}).get("id") == capture["captureId"] and
         receiving.get("capture", {}).get("sha256") == capture["captureSha256"] and
         receiving.get("reopened", {}).get("state") == "PUBLISHED", "ORIGINAL_RECEIVING_RESULT_REQUIRED")
    reports = [item for item in status["reports"] if item["captureId"] == capture["captureId"]]
    need(reports and all(item["captureId"] == capture["captureId"] for item in reports), "COMPLETE_NATIVE_REPORTS_REQUIRED")
    selection_path = root / "selection.json"
    if selection_path.exists():
        selection = parse(read(selection_path, 1024 * 1024))
    else:
        notes = native(args.checkout, args.node, ["notes", "--workspace", str(project), "--id", capture["captureId"]])
        selection = {"captureId": capture["captureId"], "captureSha256": capture["captureSha256"],
            "reportIds": [x["id"] for x in reports], "notesRevision": notes["revision"], "title": args.title}
        keep(selection_path, selection)
    keep(root / "original-receiving.json", {"project_id": status["project"]["id"],
        "receiving_id": args.receiving_id, "receiving_result_sha256": pin(project / "receiving" / args.receiving_id / "result.json")["sha256"],
        "selection": selection})
    source = DbnomicsAnalysisSource.create(project, root / "source-selected", selection,
        operation_id="economic-analysis-" + args.receiving_id, checkout=args.checkout, node=args.node)
    workflow = DbnomicsEconomicWorkflow(root / "workflow", checkout=args.checkout, node=args.node)
    review = workflow.prepare(source)
    complete = workflow.finish(preview_sha256=review["preview_sha256"], review_note=args.review_note)
    base_reopen = workflow.reopen(source_target=root / "received-economic-project")
    result = {"source": source.verify(), "review": review, "complete": complete, "base_reopen": base_reopen}
    if args.annotation is not None:
        from openpyxl import load_workbook
        need(1 <= len(args.annotation) <= 16000, "ANALYST_COMMENT_REQUIRED")
        request = keep(root / "annotation.json", {"observation_id": args.observation_id,
            "text": args.annotation, "author": args.author, "source_document_id": source.document_id})
        returned = root / "returned-economic-workbook.xlsx"
        if not returned.exists():
            book = load_workbook(complete["workbook"]["files"]["workbook.xlsx"]["path"], data_only=False, keep_links=False)
            try:
                sheet = book["Records"]
                header = {cell.value: i for i, cell in enumerate(next(sheet.iter_rows()), start=1)}
                matches = []
                for row in sheet.iter_rows(min_row=2):
                    if row[header["record_kind"] - 1].value == "observation" and row[header["observation_id"] - 1].value == args.observation_id:
                        matches.append(row[header["review_note"] - 1])
                need(len(matches) == 1, "EXACT_ORIGINAL_OBSERVATION_NOT_FOUND")
                matches[0].value = args.annotation
                matches[0].data_type = "s"
                fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".returned-economic-", suffix=".xlsx", dir=root)
                os.close(fd)
                try:
                    book.save(temporary)
                    with open(temporary, "rb") as stream:
                        write_exact(returned, stream.read())
                finally:
                    os.unlink(temporary)
            finally:
                book.close()
        returned_file = pin(returned)
        compared = workflow.return_workbook("analyst-note-return", returned, expected_sha256=returned_file["sha256"])
        accepted = workflow.accept_return("analyst-note-return", result_sha256=compared["result_sha256"],
            note="Reviewed the complete returned Records edition against its original workbook. " + args.review_note)
        adopted = workflow.adopt_notes("analyst-note-return", project, author=args.author)
        reopened = workflow.reopen(identifier="analyst-note-return", source_target=root / "returned-source-project")
        result["returned"] = {"file": returned_file, "comparison": compared, "accepted": accepted,
                              "notes_adopted": adopted, "reopened": reopened}
    # The complete returned-workbook result remains distinct from a previously
    # completed base run, so adding a later real annotation cannot disappear
    # behind that earlier immutable receiving receipt.
    result_path = root / ("result-with-return.json" if args.annotation is not None else "result.json")
    result = keep(result_path, result, identity=("source", "review", "complete"))
    print(canonical({**result, "result_file": pin(result_path)}).decode("utf-8"), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Prepare, continue and consume an actual original merchant object from Python."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import sys

from stellar_forge_buyer import BuyerError
from stellar_forge_buyer.objects import ObjectBuyer, ObjectDownloadError


def arguments(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    common = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
    common.add_argument("--checkout", required=True, help="Complete original runtime checkout")
    common.add_argument("--session", required=True, help="Private native object session directory")
    common.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=360, help="Native subprocess seconds, up to 3600")
    actions = parser.add_subparsers(dest="action", required=True)
    prepare = actions.add_parser("prepare", parents=[common], help="Select one original objects.json row offline")
    prepare.add_argument("--description", required=True)
    prepare.add_argument("--object", required=True)
    prepare.add_argument("--max-total-atomic", required=True)
    prepare.add_argument("--chunk-bytes", type=int)
    prepare.add_argument("--workspace")
    prepare.add_argument("--config")
    status = actions.add_parser("status", parents=[common])
    status.add_argument("--chunk-offset", type=int, default=0)
    status.add_argument("--chunk-limit", type=int, default=50)
    run = actions.add_parser("run", parents=[common], help="Continue native requests in an operator terminal")
    run.add_argument("--workspace")
    actions.add_parser("recover", parents=[common], help="Reopen saved native outcomes without HTTP")
    accounting = actions.add_parser("accounting", parents=[common], help="Read original chunk receipts offline")
    accounting.add_argument("--offset", type=int, default=0)
    accounting.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=100)
    finalize = actions.add_parser("finalize", parents=[common], help="Finish every original chunk reservation")
    finalize.add_argument("--workspace")
    finalize.add_argument("--page-size", type=int, default=25)
    download = actions.add_parser("download", parents=[common], help="Continue and return the complete application file")
    download.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    download.add_argument("--workspace")
    assemble = actions.add_parser("assemble", parents=[common])
    assemble.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    consume = actions.add_parser("consume", parents=[common], help="Consume an already assembled file locally")
    consume.add_argument("--out", help="Exact recorded destination, or the latest assembly when omitted")
    consume.add_argument("--as", dest="kind", choices=["binary", "csv", "json"], default="binary")
    consume.add_argument("--read-limit", type=int, default=8_388_608, help="Maximum bytes for JSON materialization")
    report = actions.add_parser("report", parents=[common])
    report.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    report.add_argument("--format", choices=["html", "json"], default="html")
    return parser.parse_args(argv)


def consume_file(delivery, kind, read_limit):
    if kind == "csv":
        rows, columns = 0, None
        # Replace this loop with the application's import_row(row). The existing
        # reader verifies the saved file, then yields rows without materializing it.
        for row in delivery.csv_rows():
            rows += 1
            if columns is None:
                columns = list(row)
        consumed = {"kind": "csv", "rows": rows, "columns": columns or []}
    elif kind == "json":
        value = delivery.json(limit=read_limit)
        consumed = {"kind": "json", "rootType": type(value).__name__,
                    "entries": len(value) if isinstance(value, (dict, list)) else 1}
    else:
        digest, count = hashlib.sha256(), 0
        with delivery.open() as stream:
            while chunk := stream.read(1_048_576):
                # Feed the same verified stream to the application's importer,
                # archive reader or upload SDK here.
                digest.update(chunk)
                count += len(chunk)
        consumed = {"kind": "binary", "consumedBytes": count, "consumedSha256": digest.hexdigest()}
    return {"localConsumption": consumed, "path": str(delivery.path),
            "assembly": delivery.assembly, "sessionId": delivery.session_id}


def main(argv=None):
    args = arguments(argv)
    buyer = ObjectBuyer(checkout=args.checkout, timeout=args.timeout)
    if args.action == "prepare":
        session = buyer.prepare(args.session, description_file=args.description,
            object_id=args.object, max_total_atomic=args.max_total_atomic,
            config_file=args.config, workspace=args.workspace, chunk_bytes=args.chunk_bytes)
        result = session.last_report.to_dict()
    else:
        session = buyer.open(args.session, inspect=args.action not in ("accounting", "finalize"))
        if args.action == "accounting":
            result = session.accounting(offset=args.offset, limit=args.limit).native
        elif args.action == "finalize":
            attention = False
            for view in session.finalize_all(workspace=args.workspace, page_size=args.page_size):
                print(json.dumps(view.native))
                attention = attention or not view.window_complete
            return 2 if attention else 0
        elif args.action == "status":
            report = session.last_report if (args.chunk_offset, args.chunk_limit) == (0, 50) else \
                session.inspect(chunk_offset=args.chunk_offset, chunk_limit=args.chunk_limit)
            result = report.to_dict()
        elif args.action in ("run", "recover"):
            report = session.run(workspace=args.workspace) if args.action == "run" else session.recover()
            print(json.dumps(report.to_dict(), indent=2))
            return 0 if report.complete or args.action == "recover" and report.status == "READY" else 2
        elif args.action in ("download", "assemble"):
            delivery = session.download(args.out, workspace=args.workspace) if args.action == "download" else \
                session.assemble(args.out)
            result = {"path": str(delivery.path), "assembly": delivery.assembly,
                      "sessionId": delivery.session_id, "receiptRecorded": delivery.receipt_recorded}
        elif args.action == "consume":
            result = consume_file(session.delivery(args.out), args.kind, args.read_limit)
        else:
            result = {"report": str(session.export_report(args.out, format=args.format))}
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main())
    except ObjectDownloadError as error:
        print(json.dumps({"error": error.code, "session": str(error.operation.directory),
                          "progress": error.progress.to_dict()}, indent=2), file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(2)
    except BuyerError as error:
        print(json.dumps({"error": error.code, "session":
            str(error.operation.directory) if error.operation else None}), file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(1)
    except OSError:
        print(json.dumps({"error": "LOCAL_OBJECT_FILE_UNAVAILABLE"}), file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Receive a finalized semantic dataset through the original DuckDB HTTP operator."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from contextlib import contextmanager
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import threading
from urllib.error import HTTPError
from urllib.parse import quote, urlsplit
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
import zipfile

from stellar_forge_buyer import DuckDBWorkspace
from stellar_forge_buyer.duckdb_http import serve
from stellar_forge_buyer.duckdb_agent import copy_sparse
from stellar_forge_buyer.storage import dump, parse, private_directory, read, write

SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.duckdb-semantic-receiving.v1"


def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def now():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


@contextmanager
def opened(workspace, directory):
    server, _, launch = serve(workspace, export_root=directory / "exports",
                             handoff_root=directory / "handoffs")
    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=False)
    thread.start()
    parts = urlsplit(launch)
    base = parts.scheme + "://" + parts.netloc
    identity = workspace.identity()["workspace_id"]

    def request(path, body=None, *, raw=False, method=None):
        headers = {"X-DuckDB-Capability": parts.fragment,
                   "X-DuckDB-Workspace-ID": identity}
        data = None
        if body is not None:
            data = json.dumps(body, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False).encode()
            headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
        req = Request(base + path, data=data, headers=headers, method=method)
        try:
            with urlopen(req, timeout=120) as response:
                payload = response.read()
                return (payload, dict(response.headers)) if raw else parse(payload)
        except HTTPError as error:
            detail = error.read(8192).decode("utf-8", "replace")
            raise RuntimeError("Native HTTP " + str(error.code) + ": " + detail) from None

    try:
        yield request
    finally:
        server.shutdown()
        thread.join()
        server.server_close()


def receive_files(request, record, destination):
    target = private_directory(destination)
    received = []
    for file in record["files"]:
        name = file["name"]
        member = PurePosixPath(name)
        require(not member.is_absolute() and all(part not in {"", ".", ".."} for part in name.split("/")),
                "Native export supplied an invalid member")
        raw, headers = request("/api/exports/" + quote(record["export_id"], safe="") +
                               "/file?name=" + quote(name, safe=""), raw=True)
        require(len(raw) == file["bytes"] and sha(raw) == file["sha256"],
                "Native export file identity changed: " + name)
        path = target / name
        private_directory(path.parent)
        if path.exists():
            require(read(path, max(len(raw), 1)) == raw, "Receiving file changed: " + name)
        else:
            write(path, raw, exclusive=True)
        received.append({"name": name, "bytes": len(raw), "sha256": sha(raw),
                         "content_type": headers.get("Content-Type")})
    return received



def exact_file(path, descriptor):
    require(path.is_file() and path.stat().st_size == descriptor["bytes"],
            "Retained receiving file is missing: " + str(path))
    with path.open("rb") as source:
        require(hashlib.file_digest(source, "sha256").hexdigest() == descriptor["sha256"],
                "Retained receiving file changed: " + str(path))


def copy_received(source, destination, descriptor):
    exact_file(source, descriptor)
    private_directory(destination.parent)
    with source.open("rb") as incoming:
        fd = os.open(destination, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as output:
            copy_sparse(incoming, output)
    exact_file(destination, descriptor)


def finish_delivery(record, directory, args, record_path):
    """Finish the original completed workflow without reopening its operations."""
    require("original_reopen" in record["steps"] and "portable_reopen" in record["steps"],
            "Complete the original native receiving before final delivery")
    roots = []
    for section, name in (("query_receiving", "downloaded-query"),
                          ("source_receiving", "downloaded-source"),
                          ("portable_receiving", "portable")):
        root = directory / name
        for descriptor in record["steps"][section]["files"]:
            exact_file(root / descriptor["name"], descriptor)
        roots.append(root)
    exact_file(directory / "semantics.json", record["steps"]["dictionary"])
    record["state"] = "COMPLETE"
    record.pop("error", None)
    record.setdefault("completed_at", now())
    dump(record_path, record)
    if args.archive:
        archive = Path(args.archive).expanduser().absolute()
        private_directory(archive.parent)
        selected = [record_path, directory / "semantics.json", *roots]
        files = [path for root in selected
                 for path in (sorted(root.rglob("*")) if root.is_dir() else [root]) if path.is_file()]
        if archive.exists():
            with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as existing:
                require(set(existing.namelist()) == {path.relative_to(directory).as_posix() for path in files},
                        "Original receiving archive member selection changed")
                for path in files:
                    require(existing.read(path.relative_to(directory).as_posix()) == path.read_bytes(),
                            "Original receiving archive changed")
        else:
            with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, "x", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as output:
                for path in files:
                    output.write(path, path.relative_to(directory).as_posix())
            archive.chmod(0o600)
    print(json.dumps({"state": record["state"], "receiving": str(record_path),
                      "workspace_id": record["workspace_id"], "rows": record["steps"]["edition"]["rows"],
                      "dictionary_sha256": record["steps"]["dictionary"]["sha256"]}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
    return record

def run(args):
    directory = private_directory(Path(args.directory))
    report = Path(args.report).expanduser().resolve(strict=True)
    source = {"report": str(report), "report_sha256": sha(read(report, 8 * 1024 * 1024)),
              "source_column": args.source_column, "sql_column": args.sql_column,
              "compare_column": args.compare_column, "view": args.view,
              "expected_rows": args.expected_rows, "expected_semantics": args.expected_semantics}
    record_path = directory / "receiving.json"
    if record_path.exists():
        record = parse(read(record_path, 8 * 1024 * 1024))
        require(record.get("schema") == SCHEMA and record.get("source") == source,
                "Continue the original receiving input and mapping")
    else:
        record = {"schema": SCHEMA, "state": "PREPARED", "created_at": now(),
                  "source": source, "steps": {}, "directory": str(directory)}
        dump(record_path, record, exclusive=True)

    def keep(name, value):
        record["steps"][name] = value
        record["updated_at"] = now()
        dump(record_path, record)
        print(json.dumps({"step": name, "state": "COMPLETE"}), flush=True)
        return value

    def retained(name, route, body, request):
        saved = record["steps"].get(name)
        if saved:
            return request("/api/exports/" + quote(saved["export_id"], safe=""))
        request_id = sha((SCHEMA + ":" + str(directory) + ":" + name).encode())[:32]
        result = request(route, {**body, "request_id": request_id})
        keep(name, {"request_id": request_id, "export_id": result["export_id"],
                    "directory": result["directory"]})
        return request("/api/exports/" + quote(result["export_id"], safe=""))

    if "original_reopen" in record["steps"]:
        return finish_delivery(record, directory, args, record_path)

    workspace = DuckDBWorkspace(directory / "warehouse", memory_limit="128MB", threads=1)
    try:
        with opened(workspace, directory) as request:
            identity = request("/api/identity")
            if record.get("workspace_id"):
                require(record["workspace_id"] == identity["workspace_id"], "Original warehouse changed")
            record["workspace_id"] = identity["workspace_id"]
            inspected = request("/api/inspect-delivery", {"report_path": str(report)})
            require(inspected.get("semantics") is not None, "This receiving workflow needs a source dictionary")
            if args.expected_rows is not None:
                require(inspected["row_count"] == args.expected_rows, "Original source row count changed")
            if args.expected_semantics:
                require(inspected["semantics"]["semantic_sha256"] == args.expected_semantics,
                        "Original source meaning changed")
            columns = [dict(column) for column in inspected["default_columns"]]
            selected = next((column for column in columns if column["source"] == args.source_column), None)
            require(selected is not None, "Select an actual published source column")
            selected["name"] = args.sql_column
            review = request("/api/reviews", {"report_path": str(report), "columns": columns,
                                              "keys": [args.sql_column]})
            edition = request("/api/import", {"review_id": review["review_id"]})
            keep("edition", {"edition_id": edition["edition_id"], "rows": edition["row_count"],
                             "manifest_sha256": edition["manifest_sha256"],
                             "semantics": edition["semantics"]})
            edition_id = edition["edition_id"]
            context = request("/api/editions/" + edition_id + "/semantics")
            original, _ = request("/api/editions/" + edition_id + "/semantics-file", raw=True)
            require(sha(original) == context["file"]["sha256"] and len(original) == context["file"]["bytes"],
                    "Original dictionary download changed")
            require(next(item for item in context["columns"] if item["source"] == args.source_column)["column"]
                    == args.sql_column, "Reviewed SQL alias lost its meaning")
            write(directory / "semantics.json", original)
            keep("dictionary", {"bytes": len(original), "sha256": sha(original),
                                "semantic_sha256": context["semantic_sha256"],
                                "definition_sha256": context["definition_sha256"],
                                "capture_manifest_sha256": context["capture_manifest_sha256"]})

            current = request("/api/state")
            view = next((view for view in current["views"] if view["name"] == args.view), None)
            request("/api/activate", {"name": args.view, "edition_id": edition_id,
                    "expected_revision": view["revision"] if view else 0})
            sql = 'SELECT * FROM "' + args.view.replace('"', '""') + '" ORDER BY sf_row'
            preview = request("/api/query", {"sql": sql, "parameters": [], "max_rows": 100})
            source_editions = preview["source_meanings"]["editions"]
            require([item["edition_id"] for item in source_editions] == [edition_id],
                    "Query source meaning did not follow the imported edition")
            require(source_editions[0]["semantics"]["semantic_sha256"] == context["semantic_sha256"],
                    "Query source definition changed")
            physical = request("/api/query", {
                "sql": 'SELECT count(*) AS observations FROM "' + edition["table"].upper() + '"',
                "parameters": [], "max_rows": 1})
            require(physical["rows"] == [[edition["row_count"]]]
                    and [item["edition_id"] for item in physical["source_meanings"]["editions"]] == [edition_id],
                    "Quoted case-insensitive physical table lost its source definition")
            keep("native_relation_receiving", {"view": preview["source_meanings"],
                    "quoted_physical_table": physical["source_meanings"],
                    "physical_rows": physical["rows"][0][0]})
            current = request("/api/state")
            query = next((query for query in current["queries"] if query["name"] == "source_meaning_receiving"), None)
            query = request("/api/queries", {"name": "source_meaning_receiving", "sql": sql,
                    "parameters": [], "expected_revision": query["revision"] if query else 0})
            exported = retained("query_export", "/api/exports", {"query_id": query["query_id"],
                    "expected_revision": query["revision"], "expected_views": preview["views"]}, request)
            require(exported["rows"] == edition["row_count"], "Complete query row count changed")
            query_files = receive_files(request, exported, directory / "downloaded-query")
            require(any(item["name"] == "source-meanings/" + edition_id + ".json"
                        and item["sha256"] == sha(original) for item in query_files),
                    "Full query receiving did not retain the original dictionary")
            keep("query_receiving", {"rows": exported["rows"], "query_id": query["query_id"],
                    "source_meanings": exported["source_meanings"], "files": query_files})

            if args.compare_column:
                altered = [dict(column) for column in columns]
                column = next((column for column in altered if column["source"] == args.compare_column), None)
                require(column is not None and column["source"] != args.source_column,
                        "Select a different source column for mapping comparison")
                names = {item["name"].casefold() for item in altered}
                alias = "compared_" + column["name"]
                while alias.casefold() in names:
                    alias = "c_" + alias
                require(len(alias) <= 128, "Comparison alias is too long")
                column["name"] = alias
                second = request("/api/reviews", {"report_path": str(report), "columns": altered,
                                                  "keys": [args.sql_column]})
                second = request("/api/import", {"review_id": second["review_id"]})
                comparison = request("/api/compare-meanings", {"before_id": edition_id,
                                     "after_id": second["edition_id"]})
                require(comparison["mapping_changed"] and not comparison["definition_changed"]
                        and not comparison["capture_changed"], "Mapping comparison changed source identity")
                row_comparison = request("/api/compare", {"before_id": edition_id,
                         "after_id": second["edition_id"], "keys": [args.sql_column], "max_rows": 100})
                require(row_comparison["source_meanings"] == {key: value for key, value in comparison.items()
                            if key not in {"before_id", "after_id"}},
                        "Row comparison lost the source-definition context")
                keep("comparison", {"candidate": second["edition_id"], "definitions": comparison,
                                    "rows": row_comparison["summary"]})

            source_export = retained("source_handoff", "/api/source-handoffs",
                                     {"edition_id": edition_id}, request)
            source_files = receive_files(request, source_export, directory / "downloaded-source")
            require(any(item["name"] == "semantics.json" and item["sha256"] == sha(original)
                        for item in source_files), "Source handoff dictionary changed")
            keep("source_receiving", {"files": source_files})
            handoff = retained("warehouse_handoff", "/api/handoffs", {}, request)
            portable = directory / "portable"
            portable_files = receive_files(request, handoff, portable)
            keep("portable_receiving", {"directory": str(portable), "files": portable_files})
        workspace.close()

        working = private_directory(directory / "portable-working")
        database = next(item for item in portable_files if item["name"] == "warehouse.duckdb")
        if not (working / "warehouse.duckdb").exists():
            copy_received(directory / "portable" / "warehouse.duckdb", working / "warehouse.duckdb", database)
        with DuckDBWorkspace(working, memory_limit="128MB", threads=1) as received:
            require(received.identity()["workspace_id"] == record["workspace_id"],
                    "Portable warehouse identity changed")
            require(received.semantics_bytes(edition_id) == original,
                    "Portable warehouse did not retain exact dictionary bytes")
            result = received.query(sql, max_rows=100)
            require(result["source_meanings"]["editions"][0]["semantics"] == context_without_document(context),
                    "Portable query source mapping changed")
            keep("portable_reopen", {"workspace_id": received.identity()["workspace_id"],
                    "edition_id": edition_id, "preview_rows": len(result["rows"]),
                    "dictionary_sha256": sha(received.semantics_bytes(edition_id))})
        with DuckDBWorkspace(directory / "warehouse", memory_limit="128MB", threads=1) as reopened:
            require(reopened.semantics_bytes(edition_id) == original, "Original reopened dictionary changed")
            result = reopened.query(sql, max_rows=100)
            keep("original_reopen", {"workspace_id": reopened.identity()["workspace_id"],
                    "preview_rows": len(result["rows"]), "source_meanings": result["source_meanings"]})
        return finish_delivery(record, directory, args, record_path)
    except BaseException as error:
        record["state"] = "INTERRUPTED"
        record["error"] = getattr(error, "code", type(error).__name__)
        record["updated_at"] = now()
        dump(record_path, record)
        raise
    finally:
        workspace.close()


def context_without_document(context):
    return {key: value for key, value in context.items()
            if key not in {"document", "version_id", "edition_id"}}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--report", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--directory", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--source-column", default="observation_id")
    parser.add_argument("--sql-column", default="observation_key")
    parser.add_argument("--compare-column", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--view", default="svk_capacity")
    parser.add_argument("--expected-rows", type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-semantics")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Continue the completed GIS customer through its original local operator."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--operation-dir", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--chromium", required=True, help="Existing compatible Chromium executable")
    parser.add_argument("--node", help="Existing Node executable")
    parser.add_argument("--playwright", help="Existing Playwright index.js")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    operation = Path(args.operation_dir).resolve(strict=True)
    native_path = operation / "native-gis-result.json"
    native_raw = native_path.read_bytes()
    native = json.loads(native_raw)
    if native.get("state") != "COMPLETE":
        raise RuntimeError("Finish the original native GIS operation before its browser continuation")
    continuation = json.loads((operation / "browser-continuation.json").read_text())
    source = hashlib.sha256(native_raw).hexdigest()
    package = Path(continuation["package"]).resolve(strict=True)
    sys.path.insert(0, str(package))
    from stellar_forge_buyer.duckdb_dataset import DuckDBWorkspace
    from stellar_forge_buyer.duckdb_http import serve
    from stellar_forge_buyer.storage import dump, private_directory

    output = private_directory(operation / "browser")
    result_path = output / "browser-result.json"
    if result_path.exists():
        previous = json.loads(result_path.read_text())
        if previous.get("native_result_sha256") != source:
            raise RuntimeError("Continue the original selected GIS result")
        if previous.get("receiving_complete") is True:
            print(json.dumps({"state": "REUSED", "result": str(result_path)}))
            return 0

    steps = {step["name"]: step["value"] for step in native["stages"]}
    node = args.node or os.environ.get("CODEX_PRIMARY_RUNTIME_NODE") or shutil.which("node")
    if not node:
        raise RuntimeError("Select the existing Node runtime")
    module_root = os.environ.get("CODEX_PRIMARY_RUNTIME_NODE_MODULES")
    playwright = args.playwright or (str(Path(module_root) / "playwright" / "index.js") if module_root else None)
    if not playwright or not Path(playwright).is_file():
        raise RuntimeError("Select the existing Playwright index.js with --playwright")
    chromium = str(Path(args.chromium).resolve(strict=True))
    if not os.access(chromium, os.X_OK):
        raise RuntimeError("The selected Chromium file is not executable")
    workspace = DuckDBWorkspace(continuation["workspace"], memory_limit="64MB", threads=1)
    server = thread = None
    token = ""
    try:
        server, control, launch = serve(workspace, spatial_extension=continuation["spatial_extension"],
            export_root=operation / "http-exports", handoff_root=operation / "http-handoffs")
        thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=False)
        thread.start()
        parts = urlsplit(launch)
        token = parts.fragment
        origin = parts.scheme + "://" + parts.netloc

        def retained_state():
            req = Request(origin + "/api/state", headers={"X-DuckDB-Capability": token})
            with urlopen(req, timeout=90) as response:
                value = json.load(response)
            return {key: value[key] for key in ("editions", "views", "queries", "reviews", "exports", "handoffs", "spatial")}

        before_path = output / "customer-state-before.json"
        current = retained_state()
        if before_path.exists():
            before = json.loads(before_path.read_text())
            if before != current:
                raise RuntimeError("The original customer changed before this browser continuation")
        else:
            before = current
            dump(before_path, before, exclusive=True)
        source_files = {}
        for module in sorted((package / "stellar_forge_buyer").glob("*.py")):
            raw = module.read_bytes()
            source_files[str(module.relative_to(package))] = hashlib.sha1(
                b"blob " + str(len(raw)).encode() + b"\0" + raw).hexdigest()
        browser_input = {
            "source_files": source_files,
            "operation": native["operation"], "native_result_sha256": source,
            "output": str(output), "workspace": continuation["workspace"],
            "url": launch, "chromium": chromium, "playwright": str(Path(playwright).resolve()),
            "review": steps["review-geometry"], "layer": steps["adopt-layer"],
            "map": steps["original-native-map"], "query": steps["save-geographic-query"],
            "export": steps["original-crs-gis-export"],
        }
        env = dict(os.environ)
        env["TMPDIR"] = str(private_directory(output / "tmp"))
        proc = subprocess.run([node, str(Path(__file__).with_suffix(".mjs"))],
            input=json.dumps(browser_input), capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=240)
        for name, content in (("browser.stdout.json", proc.stdout), ("browser.stderr.txt", proc.stderr)):
            raw = content.replace(token, "[private capability]").encode()
            path = output / name
            path.write_bytes(raw)
            path.chmod(0o600)
        if not result_path.exists():
            raise RuntimeError("Browser returned without its retained result; inspect the same operation's stderr")
        result = json.loads(result_path.read_text())
        if proc.returncode or result.get("complete") is not True:
            raise RuntimeError("Continue the original browser result: " + str(result_path))
        if retained_state() != before:
            raise RuntimeError("The original retained customer changed during the browser continuation")
        if hashlib.sha256(native_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != source:
            raise RuntimeError("The selected original native result changed")
        result["retained_customer_state_unchanged"] = True
        server.shutdown()
        thread.join()
        server.server_close()
        server = None
        workspace.close()
        result.update(host_closed=True, receiver_closed=True, receiving_complete=True,
                      closed_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
        dump(result_path, result)
        print(json.dumps({"state": "COMPLETE", "result": str(result_path),
                          "stages": len(result["stages"]), "downloads": len(result["downloads"])}))
        return 0
    finally:
        if server is not None:
            server.shutdown()
            if thread is not None:
                thread.join()
            server.server_close()
        workspace.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Operate the retained four-feature ArcGIS customer through the GIS application."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import traceback
import urllib.request
import uuid


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--package",required=True,help="Original SF88 Python package directory from this checkout")
    parser.add_argument("--original-workspace",required=True,help="Original closed/guarded four-feature ArcGIS customer")
    parser.add_argument("--operation-dir",required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--spatial-extension",required=True,help="Installed signed spatial extension matching DuckDB1.5.6")
    parser.add_argument("--chromium",help="Continue the same completed customer in an existing Chromium runtime")
    parser.add_argument("--node",help="Existing Node executable for browser continuation")
    parser.add_argument("--playwright",help="Existing Playwright index.js for browser continuation")
    args=parser.parse_args()
    package=Path(args.package).resolve(strict=True)
    original=Path(args.original_workspace).resolve(strict=True)
    operation=Path(args.operation_dir).resolve()
    operation.mkdir(mode=0o700,parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    sys.path.insert(0,str(package))
    from stellar_forge_buyer.duckdb_dataset import DuckDBWorkspace
    from stellar_forge_buyer.duckdb_spatial import DuckDBSpatial
    from stellar_forge_buyer.duckdb_http import serve
    from stellar_forge_buyer.duckdb_agent import copy_sparse
    from stellar_forge_buyer.storage import lock,dump,digest,private_directory
    result_file=operation/"native-gis-result.json"
    def finish_browser():
        if not args.chromium:return 0
        command=[sys.executable,"-B",str(Path(__file__).with_name("native_spatial_browser.py")),
                 "--operation-dir",str(operation),"--chromium",args.chromium]
        if args.node:command += ["--node",args.node]
        if args.playwright:command += ["--playwright",args.playwright]
        try:
            receiving=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
            if receiving.stdout:print(receiving.stdout,flush=True)
            if receiving.stderr:print(receiving.stderr,file=sys.stderr,flush=True)
            return receiving.returncode
        except Exception as error:
            print(json.dumps({"state":"BROWSER_INTERRUPTED","native_result":str(result_file),
                              "detail":str(error)}),flush=True)
            return 1
    source_files={}
    for module in sorted((package/"stellar_forge_buyer").glob("*.py")):
        raw=module.read_bytes()
        source_files[str(module.relative_to(package))]=hashlib.sha1(
            b"blob "+str(len(raw)).encode()+b"\0"+raw).hexdigest()
    result={"schema":"stellar-forge.duckdb-gis.native-operation.v1","operation":"SCF-DUCKDB-GIS-CUSTOMER-5EEE-20261012",
            "started_at":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"original_workspace":str(original),
            "package":str(package),"extension":str(Path(args.spatial_extension).resolve()),"stages":[]}
    if result_file.exists():
        previous=json.loads(result_file.read_text())
        if previous.get("operation")!=result["operation"] or previous.get("original_workspace")!=str(original):
            raise RuntimeError("Native operation destination belongs to another source")
        result=previous
        if result.get("state")=="COMPLETE":
            print(json.dumps({"state":"REUSED_COMPLETE_NATIVE","result":str(result_file)}),flush=True)
            return finish_browser()
    revisions=result.setdefault("source_revisions",[])
    if not revisions or revisions[-1]["files"]!=source_files:
        revisions.append({"at":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"files":source_files})
    completed={s["name"]:s["value"] for s in result["stages"]}
    def reuse(name,operation):
        if name in completed:return completed[name]
        return stage(name,operation())
    def stage(name,value):
        result["stages"].append({"name":name,"value":value})
        dump(result_file,result)
        print(json.dumps({"stage":name,"complete":True}),flush=True)
        return value
    def hash_file(path):
        with open(path,"rb") as stream:return hashlib.file_digest(stream,"sha256").hexdigest()
    def check(condition,message):
        if not condition:raise AssertionError(message)
    server=None
    try:
        workspace_dir=private_directory(operation/"customer")
        if not (workspace_dir/"warehouse.duckdb").exists():
            with lock(original):
                check(not (original/"warehouse.duckdb.wal").exists(),"Original warehouse has an active WAL; finish its current operation first")
                original_hash=hash_file(original/"warehouse.duckdb")
                with open(original/"warehouse.duckdb","rb") as source,open(workspace_dir/"warehouse.duckdb","xb") as destination:
                    copy_sparse(source,destination,1024*1024)
                    destination.flush();os.fsync(destination.fileno())
                os.chmod(workspace_dir/"warehouse.duckdb",0o600)
                check(hash_file(workspace_dir/"warehouse.duckdb")==original_hash,"Original warehouse copy changed")
                dump(operation/"original-source.json",{"original_workspace":str(original),"warehouse_sha256":original_hash})
        stage("original-source",json.loads((operation/"original-source.json").read_text()))
        workspace=DuckDBWorkspace(workspace_dir,memory_limit="64MB",threads=1)
        gis=DuckDBSpatial(workspace,extension_path=args.spatial_extension)
        runtime=stage("native-spatial-runtime",gis.runtime())
        check(runtime["duckdb"]=="1.5.6","Operate the exact1.5.6 runtime")
        editions=workspace.editions(limit=100)["editions"]
        candidates=[e for e in editions if e["row_count"]==4 and {"GEOID","geometry_json","spatial_reference_json"}.issubset({c["name"] for c in e["columns"]})]
        check(len(candidates)>=1,"The original four-feature ArcGIS edition is required")
        edition=sorted(candidates,key=lambda e:e["sequence"])[0]
        stage("original-edition",edition)
        review=stage("review-geometry",gis.review_layer(edition["edition_id"],geometry_column="geometry_json",
            source_format="esri-json",crs="EPSG:3857",spatial_reference_column="spatial_reference_json",
            geometry_type="esriGeometryPolygon",keys=["object_id"]))
        check(review["row_count"]==4 and review["source_spatial_reference"]["latestWkid"]==3857,"Original CRS and rows")
        check(review["coordinate_count"]>0 and review["transformation"] is None,"Original coordinates retained")
        check(gis.review_layer(edition["edition_id"],geometry_column="geometry_json",source_format="esri-json",
            crs="EPSG:3857",spatial_reference_column="spatial_reference_json",geometry_type="esriGeometryPolygon",
            keys=["object_id"])==review,"Same review must reopen")
        layer=stage("adopt-layer",gis.adopt_layer(review["review_id"]))
        check(gis.adopt_layer(review["review_id"])==layer,"Layer adoption is idempotent")
        prior=next((v for v in gis.status()["bindings"]["layers"] if v["name"]=="current_map"),None)
        stage("activate-layer",gis.activate("current_map",layer["layer_id"],expected_revision=prior["revision"] if prior else 0))
        stage("original-native-map",gis.preview(layer["layer_id"]))
        area=stage("projected-area",gis.query("SELECT object_id,GEOID,ST_Area(ST_Transform(geometry,'EPSG:5070')) AS area_m2 FROM current_map ORDER BY object_id"))
        check(len(area["rows"])==4 and all(row[2]>0 for row in area["rows"]),"Native projected polygon areas")
        extent=review["extent"]
        bounds=[extent[0],extent[1],(extent[0]+extent[2])/2,extent[3]]
        selection=stage("spatial-selection",gis.query("SELECT object_id,GEOID FROM current_map WHERE ST_Intersects(geometry,ST_SetCRS(ST_MakeEnvelope(?,?,?,?),'EPSG:3857')) ORDER BY object_id",bounds))
        sql="SELECT * FROM current_map ORDER BY object_id"
        existing=next((q for q in gis.status()["queries"] if q["name"]=="arcgis_original_gis"),None)
        saved=reuse("save-gis-query",lambda:gis.save_query("arcgis_original_gis",sql,expected_revision=existing["revision"] if existing else 0))
        preview=reuse("spatial-query-preview",lambda:gis.query(sql))
        export=stage("original-crs-gis-export",gis.export_query(saved["query_id"],operation/"exports"/"original",
            expected_revision=saved["revision"],expected_bindings=preview["bindings"]))
        check(export["rows"]==4 and export["receiving"]["state"]=="COMPLETE","Original GeoPackage/GeoParquet receiving")
        check(all(export["receiving"][key]==0 for key in ("parquet_minus_gpkg","gpkg_minus_parquet")),"Exact two-way native receiving")
        original_files={f["name"]:(f["bytes"],f["sha256"]) for f in export["files"]}
        revised=reuse("save-query-revision",lambda:gis.save_query("arcgis_original_gis","SELECT * FROM current_map WHERE object_id=-1",expected_revision=saved["revision"]))
        reused=stage("reopen-original-export",gis.export_query(saved["query_id"],operation/"exports"/"original",expected_revision=saved["revision"]))
        check(original_files=={f["name"]:(f["bytes"],f["sha256"]) for f in reused["files"]},"Original saved file bytes after SQL revision")
        transformed_query=reuse("save-geographic-query",lambda:gis.save_query("arcgis_geographic",sql,expected_revision=0))
        transformed=stage("reprojected-gis-export",gis.export_query(transformed_query["query_id"],operation/"exports"/"geographic",
            expected_revision=transformed_query["revision"],target_crs="EPSG:4326"))
        check(transformed["transformation"]=={"source":"EPSG:3857","target":"EPSG:4326"},"Actual CRS transformation recorded")
        empty_query=reuse("save-empty-query",lambda:gis.save_query("arcgis_empty","SELECT * FROM current_map WHERE false",expected_revision=0))
        empty=stage("empty-typed-gis-export",gis.export_query(empty_query["query_id"],operation/"exports"/"empty",expected_revision=empty_query["revision"]))
        check(empty["rows"]==0 and empty["crs"]=="EPSG:3857","Empty GIS layer preserves schema/CRS")
        if len(candidates)>1:
            second=sorted(candidates,key=lambda e:e["sequence"])[1]
            next_review=gis.review_layer(second["edition_id"],geometry_column="geometry_json",source_format="esri-json",
                crs="EPSG:3857",spatial_reference_column="spatial_reference_json",geometry_type="esriGeometryPolygon",keys=["object_id"])
            next_layer=gis.adopt_layer(next_review["review_id"])
            active=next(v for v in gis.status()["bindings"]["layers"] if v["name"]=="current_map")
            stage("second-mapping-active-layer",gis.activate("current_map",next_layer["layer_id"],expected_revision=active["revision"]))
            old=gis.export_query(saved["query_id"],operation/"exports"/"original",expected_revision=saved["revision"])
            check(original_files=={f["name"]:(f["bytes"],f["sha256"]) for f in old["files"]},"Original export after layer revision")
        stage("portable-workspace",workspace.backup(operation/"portable"))
        workspace.close()
        receiver=DuckDBWorkspace(operation/"portable",memory_limit="64MB",threads=1)
        receiver_gis=DuckDBSpatial(receiver,extension_path=args.spatial_extension)
        stage("portable-layer-reopen",receiver_gis.status())
        stage("portable-spatial-query",receiver_gis.query("SELECT count(*) FROM current_map"))
        independent=DuckDBWorkspace(operation/"independent",memory_limit="64MB",threads=1)
        stage("independent-gis-receiving",DuckDBSpatial(independent,extension_path=args.spatial_extension).receive_files(operation/"exports"/"original"))
        independent.close()
        env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=str(package),PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1")
        cli=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B","-m","stellar_forge_buyer.duckdb_cli","--workspace",str(operation/"portable"),
             "--spatial-extension",args.spatial_extension,"spatial","query","--sql","SELECT count(*) FROM current_map"],
             env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
        check(cli.returncode==0,cli.stderr)
        stage("installed-cli",json.loads(cli.stdout))
        server,control,url=serve(receiver,spatial_extension=args.spatial_extension,
                                 export_root=operation/"http-exports",handoff_root=operation/"http-handoffs")
        thread=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
        base,token=url.split("#")
        def request(path,body=None):
            headers={"X-DuckDB-Capability":token}
            data=None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode()
            if body is not None:headers["Content-Type"]="application/json"
            with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(base.rstrip("/")+path,data=data,headers=headers),timeout=90) as response:
                raw=response.read();return response.status,response.headers.get_content_type(),raw
        code,mime,raw=request("/api/spatial/state")
        check(code==200 and len(json.loads(raw)["layers"])>=1,"HTTP GIS state")
        stage("http-spatial-query",json.loads(request("/api/spatial/query",{"sql":"SELECT count(*) FROM current_map"})[2]))
        for asset in ("/","/app.js","/spatial.js","/style.css"):
            code,mime,raw=request(asset);check(code==200 and len(raw)>100,"Complete original UI asset "+asset)
        # Original export descriptors are in the portable DB; its exact exported files remain in this operation.
        for file in export["files"]:
            if file["name"] in {"result.gpkg","result.parquet"}:
                path="/api/exports/"+export["export_id"]+"/file?name="+file["name"]
                code,mime,raw=request(path);check(code==200 and digest(raw)==file["sha256"],"Exact HTTP GIS file "+file["name"])
        stage("http-gis-downloads",{"files":["result.gpkg","result.parquet"],"complete":True})
        # Browser continuation uses this same operated workspace and host-selected extension.
        dump(operation/"browser-continuation.json",{"package":str(package),"workspace":str(operation/"portable"),
             "spatial_extension":args.spatial_extension,"layer_id":layer["layer_id"],"query_id":saved["query_id"],
             "export_id":export["export_id"],"source_result":str(result_file)})
        server.shutdown();server.server_close();thread.join(timeout=5);server=None;receiver.close()
        result.pop("error",None)
        result.update(state="COMPLETE",completed_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
        dump(result_file,result);print(json.dumps({"state":"COMPLETE","result":str(result_file),"stages":len(result["stages"])}),flush=True)
        return finish_browser()
    except BaseException as exc:
        result.update(state="INTERRUPTED",error={"type":type(exc).__name__,"code":getattr(exc,"code",None),
                      "detail":str(exc),"traceback":traceback.format_exc()},updated_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
        try:dump(result_file,result)
        except Exception:pass
        print(json.dumps({"state":"INTERRUPTED","result":str(result_file),"error":result["error"]}),flush=True)
        return 1
    finally:
        if server is not None:
            server.shutdown();server.server_close()


if __name__=="__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
